question: What is the exact circuit-level fault-tolerant threshold p_2q,th, logical error rate eps_L(d), suppression factor Lambda, missing-cell super-stabilizer degradation d_eff(N_cand), and physical-to-logical resource scaling (d*, N_active, N_phys_per_logical, LD400/PT420 modular cryostat count for 100 logical qubits) of the v5.0 Atom Lithography Machine M4 rotated surface code using exact Exp137 Pauli-16 + Exp140 MUX readout + Exp136 T2e/yield + Exp139 Rota C + Exp132 BOED FNR inputs?

model.code_family: Rotated planar surface code (d = 3, 5, 7, 9, 11), n_data = d^2, n_anc = d^2 - 1, n_total = 2 d^2 - 1
model.syndrome_rounds: d rounds of circuit-level 4-step CZ syndrome extraction + final ideal transversal readout
model.decoder: Exact Edmonds Blossom MWPM (networkx.min_weight_matching) over circuit-level 3D Detector Error Model (DEM) with separate left/right (top/bottom) virtual boundary nodes
model.two_qubit_noise: Exact 15-term non-identity Pauli-16 channel from Exp137 part4_exp138_pauli_channels scaled to Exp137 part3_2d_phase_map (Q_r, S_eps) points, plus explicit leakage-to-depolarizing LRU sensitivity check
model.one_qubit_and_idle_noise: p_1q from Exp126 Rx_pi2 (0.00083), p_meas from Exp140 N_mux*=32 at tau_ro=2us (0.003861) and 3us sensitivity (0.002232), p_idle from Exp136 XY8-N64 T2e over full 4-CZ + readout syndrome cycle T_cyc = 4*t_gate + tau_ro + 0.2 us
model.defect_model: Exact gauge-deformed super-stabilizer merging around missing data qubits (preserving H_X_def @ H_Z_def^T = 0 mod 2), dead ancilla puncturing, weight-scaled measurement noise, and exact shortest-path effective distance d_eff

predictions.description: Exact rotated surface code algebra (2d^2-1 qubits, H_X H_Z^T = 0 mod 2, exact logical operators, d_eff = d at p_drop = 0) and circuit-level MWPM threshold p_2q,th under exact Exp137 Pauli-16 + Exp140 p_meas=0.003861 falls cleanly in [0.0070, 0.0200].

Scenario A (v4.0 Bare P1, S=1.0, p_2q=0.3925) and Scenario B (v5.0 Unpassivated Route A + P4, S=1.0, both 6-pair p_2q=0.0665 and fast-pair p_2q=0.0279) are all strictly above threshold: Lambda < 1.0 and eps_L(d=7) > eps_L(d=3).

Scenario D (v5.0 Rota C P4, Q_r=5e5, S_eps=0.25 uev/rtHz, p_2q=0.0092) crosses below circuit-level threshold with Lambda > 1.15 and eps_L(d=11) < eps_L(d=3), while deep-FT target D_target (p_2q=0.0050) achieves Lambda >= 2.0.
predictions.criterion: D_S0p25_Lambda > 1.15 and D_S0p25_eps_d11 < D_S0p25_eps_d3 and D_target_Lambda >= 2.0

predictions.description: Both Z-memory and X-memory circuits are decoded independently under exact Exp137 Pauli-16; combined logical error eps_L_tot = 1 - (1 - eps_X)(1 - eps_Z) >= max(eps_X, eps_Z) everywhere, and mild Z-bias preserves p_2q_th_Zmem >= 0.90 * p_2q_th_Xmem.

Gauge-deformed super-stabilizer matrices commute (H_X_def H_Z_def^T = 0 mod 2) on 100% of realizations. At f=1.0%: N_cand=1 (p_drop=48.6%) breaks patch (mean d_eff(d=7) < 2.0), N_cand=3 (p_drop=11.45%) degrades d_eff/d < 0.85, N_cand=6 (p_drop=1.31%) preserves mean d_eff/d >= 0.85 and survival >= 98%. At f*=1.5%+2MV/m: N_cand=3 preserves d_eff/d >= 0.85 and N_cand=6 preserves d_eff/d >= 0.99. Exp132 BOED FNR=0.201% shifts p_drop(N_cand=6) by < 0.0005.
predictions.criterion: all_superstab_commute and f1_N1_broken and f1_N3_degraded and f1_N6_preserved and f15_N3_preserved and f15_N6_near_ideal and boed_fnr_delta_pdrop_N6 < 0.0005

predictions.description: Exponential fit eps_L(d) = A * Lambda^(-(d+1)/2) produces finite odd d*, N_active=2d*^2-1, N_phys_per_logical=N_cand*N_active, and LD400/PT420 modular cryostat counts for 100 logical qubits at eps_L in {1e-6, 1e-9, 1e-12}, exported under Exp141-compatible top-level key 'target_logical_error_rates'.

Primary Monte Carlo curves use >= 2000 shots/point with Wilson 95% CIs, zero hardcoded user paths across code/results/tests, valid 2400x1400 PNG figure, 0 GFM errors in summary_exp138.md, and >= 8 passing pytest checks in tests/test_exp138.py.
predictions.criterion: min_shots >= 2000 and hardcoded_path_hits == 0 and no_lab_measurement == True

success_rule: At least 5/7 pre-registered predictions PASS with 100% honest reporting of any FAIL (no post-hoc threshold modification) and zero algebra/commutation/portability defects.
